title: Mosaic Orca Vision
description: A close-up portrait of an orca whale's head rendered in vibrant mosaic tile style, featuring a large multicolored human-like eye at its center. The orca wears an ornate pearl necklace with seaweed strands and a smaller orca silhouette pendant, set against a dark abstract background with floating eyes and crystalline shards.
